crux.for_the_english: KEEP THE SNOW LITERAL, SUDDEN AND UNEXPLAINED, AND KEEP A RIGID CONCORDANCE FOR THE REPEATED PHRASES — 'in one breath/at one go,' 'hold it in my head,' 'Nancy Lee,' 'telephone,' 'terrible blizzard,' 'snowscape' — SO THE CATALOGUE IN p160 LANDS AS SELF-QUOTATION. DO NOT SMOOTH THE SUMMER/SNOW INVERSION INTO A SIMILE FOR HIS STATE OF MIND.
crux.point: TAKI SEES THE WORLD IN REVERSE SEASON: HIS 'FINISHED' SUMMER SEASCAPE LOOKS — RIGHTLY — LIKE A SNOWSCAPE, BECAUSE HE LIVES IN AN UNWRITTEN, 'HELD-IN-THE-HEAD' FANTASY AND IS BLIND TO WHAT IS IN FRONT OF HIM.
crux.why: THE WIFE'S CASUAL LINE IN p58 TRIGGERS NOT EMBARRASSMENT BUT A FULL MID-SUMMER BLIZZARD HALLUCINATION IN p61-62 (OWL'S EYES IN DAYLIGHT, BURIED UNDER SIN-FUL SNOW 'AS LARGE AS PEONY PETALS'). THE SAME WORDS KEEP RECURRING — 架空 MADE OF AIR, 夢, 'IN ONE BREATH' (p28, p74-75), THE SIX-DAY JOB HE MUST ONLY 'HOLD IN HIS HEAD' (p135, p160) — AND IN p160 THE NARRATOR LISTS THEM BACK VERBATIM TO SHOW THEM ALL SCATTERED 'LIKE GOOSE DOWN' THE MOMENT MONEY APPEARS. THAT MAKES THE TITLE AN INDICTMENT, NOT A MOOD.

crux.for_the_english: KEEP THREE REGISTERS SHARPLY APART IN PLAIN, SPEAKABLE ENGLISH: HIS EVASIVE MUMBLE AND FALSE GRANDIOSES, THE WIFE'S BRISK DOMESTIC LOGIC, AND THE WORKMEN'S COARSE, COMPRESSED ROUGH-SPEECH (WITHOUT EYE-DIALECT CARICATURE). ABOVE ALL KEEP TAKI'S SLIDE INTO IMITATION OF A (p165-176) BRUTAL AND COMIC — IT MUST SOUND LIKE A DIFFERENT MAN FROM THE 'SNOWSCAPE' REVERIE, NOT A POLISHED NARRATOR SUMMARISING.
crux.point: THE COMEDY AND THE VERDICT ARE IN THE COLLISION OF REGISTERS: LYRICAL, MOCK-HEROIC NARRATION OF A MUDDY POND-SIEGE AGAINST THE WORKMEN'S VULGAR DIALECT — AND TAKI, WHO CLAIMED NO FEELING FOR ANYTHING (p18), BECOMES A SHOUTING, TABLE-THUMPING 'GRAND BOURGEOIS' (p160) THE INSTANT THE DESPISED CARP ARE WORTH ¥400.
crux.why: A AND B SPEAK IN HEAVILY ELIDED, ROUGH VERNACULAR (p40-47, WITH THE NARRATOR EVEN GLOSSING 手前え AS 'FIRST PERSON'), AND THEIR BODIES — DRAGON AND UNFINISHED HANNYA TATTOOS (p48) — ARE GIVEN THE EPIC DESCRIPTION TAKI'S OWN WORK NEVER GETS. THE POND BATTLE (p154-193) IS NARRATED AS WARFARE, THEN UNDER-CUT BY 'A WATER-FIGHT ON A HOT DAY.' TAKI FIRST EAVESDROPS, THEN IMITATES A'S CADENCE, ORDERS THE CARP BEATEN TO DEATH (p173), AND BY p210 HIS CREDITORS ARE PUMPING THE POND TO THE RHYTHM OF NANCY LEE'S CHORUS WHILE HE IS ABSENT IN TOKYO BUYING A LAMP.

data.say: CONFIDENCE: HIGH ON BOTH. WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: EVIDENCE IN THE JAPANESE THAT THE REPEATED PHRASES I CALL DELIBERATE ECHOES ARE UNMARKED STOCK PHRASES WITH NO RETURN-VALUE IN p160 WOULD DEMOTE THE FIRST FROM A CRUX TO ORDINARY CONSISTENCY OF TERMINOLOGY.
